claims.text: The driver's own trace measures the effective in-geofence dwell at 195 seconds — one unbroken run of 21 qualifying fixes from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 — against the 300-second minimum for a STANDARD pickup. That is a 105-second shortfall, and under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full; POL-NS-01 limb (c) is simply not met.

POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and the driver must carry all four limbs. Limb (b) is satisfied — the trace holds 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with the closest fix at 18.7 m — but limb (c) is not, because the required continuous dwell is 300 seconds and the trace shows 195. One broken limb is enough: the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06.

The driver cannot repair the shortfall by accumulating separate in-geofence intervals. There is only one such interval on this trace (run_count 1, longest run 195 seconds), and POL-NS-06 limb (i) in any event requires a traffic advisory that is present and populated with a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING — its weight is 0.0 and the absence is itself citable — so no advisory covers this pickup road in this window, limb (i) is unavailable, and the 195-second measurement stands as the effective dwell.

No driver compensation is payable on this record. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-01 is not; POL-NS-06 says expressly that where the dwell falls short of the minimum the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable. The rider should therefore end up paying nothing, not 20 percent of a fee that was never earned.

Nothing here requires the fee to be held for human review. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 131, a rate of 0.0153 — below both the count of 4 and the 0.08 ratio the clause requires. Those are the only profile fields the clauses name; the rest of both profiles (rating, account age, lifetime counters including prior_no_show_flags) is context only and grounds nothing under POL-GEN-01.

The rider was not an absent no-show, which is what the RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code describes. Her device track carries 60 fixes, every one of them qualifying, all inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius and never more than 51.6 m from the pin — a rider at the pickup point, consistent with her account of a slow block lift, not one who never came. I note that POL-NS-04 does not itself carry the ruling on these facts, because the driver's 19:44:31 message sits 101 seconds after the rider's 19:42:50 message and so falls inside the clause's 120-second reply window; the rider's presence is nonetheless affirmatively established under limb (c).

The chat log shows the driver's own choice rather than any abandonment by the rider: the system announced arrival at 19:41:36, the rider messaged at 19:42:50 that she was coming, and the driver's only reply, at 19:44:31, was 'cannot wait already ah, cancelling' — with the cancellation recorded at 19:44:40, roughly 100 seconds before a 300-second waiting period measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (19:41:20) would have matured. EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED: issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, weight 0.85, because the rider's message is contestable between 'I am on my way' and 'I am already here'. I disclose that discount; the timing point survives it because it rests on message timestamps that the language issue does not touch.

The sum in issue is exactly the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line, and it reconciles with the fee schedule: the STANDARD zone-class fee is 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is 4.00, so the greater-of figure under the resolution rule is 4.00. There is no other contested line — base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare and platform_fee are all 0.00 — so a full refund returns the whole contested amount, which is what POL-GEN-03 means by FULL_REFUND, and per POL-NS-06 only the cancellation-fee line is refunded.

claims.text: The driver genuinely reached the pickup pin. EV-TRIP-00203 records a driver 'arrived' event at 19:41:35, and EV-GPS-00203 (60 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps, weight 1.0) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:41:20 onward, with 21 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes whose reported accuracy is 5-11 m, comfortably inside the 25 m filter, and a closest approach of 18.7 m to the pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are therefore satisfied on clean, unimpaired evidence: this was a real arrival at the pin, not a marker tapped from a moving car.

POL-NS-05 does not bite on this driver. At and around the 'arrived' marker he was stationary at the pin: the only speeds recorded across the whole trip are 0.0 and 29.6 kph, the 29.6 kph belonging to the approach whose moving fixes fail the POL-NS-02 accuracy filter, so he was nowhere near the 15 kph motion trigger; and at 18.7 m from the pin he was nowhere near the 300 m trigger either. The arrival marker is therefore NOT false, the waiting clock is not recomputed on a false-marker basis, and no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list against a driver who actually parked at the pin.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (b) fails. The rider's single message was sent at 19:42:50 and the driver answered in the same chat at 19:44:31 - 101 seconds later, inside the 120-second window, and before he terminated the trip at 19:44:40 - and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. I disclose that the chat log EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY on MSG-00203-002. That impairment goes to what the rider's message means, not to the sent-at timestamps on which limb (b) turns, so the point survives the discount.

Even taken at face value, the rider's message 'wait ah, i coming liao' is not a locating or coordinating message within POL-NS-04(a): it names no block, entrance, tower or bay, gives no position, asks no question and states nothing about being unable to see the vehicle. It also arrived at 19:42:50, 75 seconds after the driver's arrival marker, by which time the driver was already holding at the pin. The admissibility pre-pass itself records the message as genuinely contestable between 'I am on my way' and 'I am already here' (LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, weight 0.85 - disclosed); on neither reading does it tell the driver where to go, so there was nothing for him to move to.

The rider's own device was at the pickup point and did not board. The rider track inside EV-GPS-00203 is present and unimpaired, and all 60 of its fixes sit between 36.4 m and 51.6 m from the pin - inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius - with the rider stationary at 0.0 kph throughout the 19:43:12 to 19:46:00 window. The rider was therefore not walking down to the car in the 88 seconds before the driver cancelled, contrary to the claim text, and never boarded, although the trip ended as a driver-cancelled RIDER_NO_SHOW. In substance the driver waited at the pin for a rider who was already there and stayed put.

There is no fare-integrity defect that could support a partial refund or an integrity escalation. The SGD 4.00 charged is exactly the figure fixed by fee_schedule.resolution_rule - the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) - and it reconciles with fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. Every other line on EV-FARE-00203 (base fare, distance, time, waiting, platform fee, surcharges, tolls, promo) is zero, so if any refund issues at all it is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line and nothing beyond it.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so this case should be decided rather than parked in a human queue. Both profiles show disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0, so limb (c)'s two-or-more same-pair no-show disputes in 90 days is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb (d) requires, and I do not rely on the lifetime prior_no_show_flags, which is context only under POL-GEN-01; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; and the dwell finding is carried by EV-GPS-00203 at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor by POL-GEN-02. A clean record deserves a ruling.

I concede the arithmetic, and I do not ask the judge to call 195 seconds 300. The driver's in-geofence hold runs from his first qualifying fix at 19:41:20 to his last at 19:44:35 - 195 seconds on a single continuous run of 21 fixes - against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 105 seconds; he cancelled at 19:44:40, roughly 200 seconds after that first fix. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore not met, and limb (d)'s requirement that termination come at or after the required dwell fails with it, so the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06 obliges a refund. I do not attempt limb (i) accumulation on top of that: the trace shows only one in-geofence run, so there is no second interval to sum, and EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - disclosed) - I assert nothing against that absent artifact. What the driver asks in return is narrow: that the ruling record a genuine arrival at the pin and a genuine 195-second hold, and impose nothing beyond the return of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee - no POL-NS-05 false-arrival referral against a driver who was stationary 18.7 m from the pin, and no POL-NS-09 escalation.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the decisive arithmetic and so do I, so this is decided rather than escalated.

Did the driver arrive? Yes. EV-TRIP-00203 records the driver 'arrived' event at 19:41:35, and EV-GPS-00203 (weight 1.0, 60 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:41:20, with 21 consecutive qualifying fixes whose reported accuracy is 5-11 m (well inside the 25 m filter) and a closest approach of 18.7 m to the pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are met. The arrival marker is not false: he was stationary at 0.0 kph at 18.7 m, so neither the 300 m distance trigger nor the 15 kph motion trigger in POL-NS-05 fires, and no false-arrival entry is recorded against him.

Why the fee still fails. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive, and limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. The driver's own trace measures a single unbroken run of 195 seconds (19:41:20 to 19:44:35) against that 300-second minimum - a shortfall of 105 seconds - and he cancelled at 19:44:40. Limb (c) is not met and limb (d)'s requirement that termination come at or after the dwell elapsed fails with it. POL-NS-06 then makes the result automatic: the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full. Accumulation under POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable on this trace - there is only one in-geofence run to sum, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no advisory permits summing and none exonerates anyone.

POL-NS-07 cannot pay the driver. The 80 percent compensation is payable only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not; POL-NS-06 states expressly that a shortfall yields the full refund and no driver compensation.

POL-NS-04 does not carry this ruling in either direction. The rider's message at 19:42:50 was answered by the driver at 19:44:31, 101 seconds later and therefore inside the clause's 120-second window, so limb (b) fails and the clause does not apply. Separately, her rider track inside EV-GPS-00203 (all 60 fixes between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pin, stationary throughout 19:43:12 to 19:46:00) affirmatively places her at the pickup point, consistent with her account of a slow block lift and not with an absent no-show.

No escalation arises. The deciding fact - the 195-second dwell - is carried by EV-GPS-00203 at weight 1.0, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 1.0 and POL-NS-09(a) is not engaged. Both profiles show disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that POL-NS-09(d) requires; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test does not trip (2 no-show terminations against 131 completed trips, a rate of 0.015, below both the count of 4 and the 0.08 ratio); no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; and the deciding fact does not rest solely on an impaired artifact.

On the evidence itself: the chat log EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, because the rider's 'wait ah, i coming liao' is genuinely contestable between 'I am on my way' and 'I am already here'. The finding does not rest on it - both the dwell and the timeline rest on the unimpaired GPS trace - so the discount does not change the outcome. The fare breakdown reconciles exactly: SGD 4.00 is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect, and base fare, distance, time, waiting, platform fee, surcharges, tolls and promo are all zero.

Outcome for both parties: the whole contested SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is returned to the rider. The driver receives no compensation, because the waiting period the fee is consideration for was never completed. No referral is made, since no clause on these facts produces one.

ledger.claim: The driver's own trace measures the effective in-geofence dwell at 195 seconds — one unbroken run of 21 qualifying fixes from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35 — against the 300-second minimum for a STANDARD pickup. That is a 105-second shortfall, and under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full; POL-NS-01 limb (c) is simply not met.

POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and the driver must carry all four limbs. Limb (b) is satisfied — the trace holds 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with the closest fix at 18.7 m — but limb (c) is not, because the required continuous dwell is 300 seconds and the trace shows 195. One broken limb is enough: the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06.

The driver cannot repair the shortfall by accumulating separate in-geofence intervals. There is only one such interval on this trace (run_count 1, longest run 195 seconds), and POL-NS-06 limb (i) in any event requires a traffic advisory that is present and populated with a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING — its weight is 0.0 and the absence is itself citable — so no advisory covers this pickup road in this window, limb (i) is unavailable, and the 195-second measurement stands as the effective dwell.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-00203-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ledger.claim: No driver compensation is payable on this record. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-01 is not; POL-NS-06 says expressly that where the dwell falls short of the minimum the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable. The rider should therefore end up paying nothing, not 20 percent of a fee that was never earned.

Nothing here requires the fee to be held for human review. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 131, a rate of 0.0153 — below both the count of 4 and the 0.08 ratio the clause requires. Those are the only profile fields the clauses name; the rest of both profiles (rating, account age, lifetime counters including prior_no_show_flags) is context only and grounds nothing under POL-GEN-01.

The rider was not an absent no-show, which is what the RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code describes. Her device track carries 60 fixes, every one of them qualifying, all inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius and never more than 51.6 m from the pin — a rider at the pickup point, consistent with her account of a slow block lift, not one who never came. I note that POL-NS-04 does not itself carry the ruling on these facts, because the driver's 19:44:31 message sits 101 seconds after the rider's 19:42:50 message and so falls inside the clause's 120-second reply window; the rider's presence is nonetheless affirmatively established under limb (c).

The chat log shows the driver's own choice rather than any abandonment by the rider: the system announced arrival at 19:41:36, the rider messaged at 19:42:50 that she was coming, and the driver's only reply, at 19:44:31, was 'cannot wait already ah, cancelling' — with the cancellation recorded at 19:44:40, roughly 100 seconds before a 300-second waiting period measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (19:41:20) would have matured. EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED: issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, weight 0.85, because the rider's message is contestable between 'I am on my way' and 'I am already here'. I disclose that discount; the timing point survives it because it rests on message timestamps that the language issue does not touch.

The sum in issue is exactly the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line, and it reconciles with the fee schedule: the STANDARD zone-class fee is 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is 4.00, so the greater-of figure under the resolution rule is 4.00. There is no other contested line — base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare and platform_fee are all 0.00 — so a full refund returns the whole contested amount, which is what POL-GEN-03 means by FULL_REFUND, and per POL-NS-06 only the cancellation-fee line is refunded.

The driver genuinely reached the pickup pin. EV-TRIP-00203 records a driver 'arrived' event at 19:41:35, and EV-GPS-00203 (60 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps, weight 1.0) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:41:20 onward, with 21 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes whose reported accuracy is 5-11 m, comfortably inside the 25 m filter, and a closest approach of 18.7 m to the pin. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are therefore satisfied on clean, unimpaired evidence: this was a real arrival at the pin, not a marker tapped from a moving car.

POL-NS-05 does not bite on this driver. At and around the 'arrived' marker he was stationary at the pin: the only speeds recorded across the whole trip are 0.0 and 29.6 kph, the 29.6 kph belonging to the approach whose moving fixes fail the POL-NS-02 accuracy filter, so he was nowhere near the 15 kph motion trigger; and at 18.7 m from the pin he was nowhere near the 300 m trigger either. The arrival marker is therefore NOT false, the waiting clock is not recomputed on a false-marker basis, and no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list against a driver who actually parked at the pin.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (b) fails. The rider's single message was sent at 19:42:50 and the driver answered in the same chat at 19:44:31 - 101 seconds later, inside the 120-second window, and before he terminated the trip at 19:44:40 - and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. I disclose that the chat log EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY on MSG-00203-002. That impairment goes to what the rider's message means, not to the sent-at timestamps on which limb (b) turns, so the point survives the discount.

Even taken at face value, the rider's message 'wait ah, i coming liao' is not a locating or coordinating message within POL-NS-04(a): it names no block, entrance, tower or bay, gives no position, asks no question and states nothing about being unable to see the vehicle. It also arrived at 19:42:50, 75 seconds after the driver's arrival marker, by which time the driver was already holding at the pin. The admissibility pre-pass itself records the message as genuinely contestable between 'I am on my way' and 'I am already here' (LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, weight 0.85 - disclosed); on neither reading does it tell the driver where to go, so there was nothing for him to move to.

The rider's own device was at the pickup point and did not board. The rider track inside EV-GPS-00203 is present and unimpaired, and all 60 of its fixes sit between 36.4 m and 51.6 m from the pin - inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius - with the rider stationary at 0.0 kph throughout the 19:43:12 to 19:46:00 window. The rider was therefore not walking down to the car in the 88 seconds before the driver cancelled, contrary to the claim text, and never boarded, although the trip ended as a driver-cancelled RIDER_NO_SHOW. In substance the driver waited at the pin for a rider who was already there and stayed put.

There is no fare-integrity defect that could support a partial refund or an integrity escalation. The SGD 4.00 charged is exactly the figure fixed by fee_schedule.resolution_rule - the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) - and it reconciles with fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. Every other line on EV-FARE-00203 (base fare, distance, time, waiting, platform fee, surcharges, tolls, promo) is zero, so if any refund issues at all it is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line and nothing beyond it.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so this case should be decided rather than parked in a human queue. Both profiles show disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0, so limb (c)'s two-or-more same-pair no-show disputes in 90 days is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb (d) requires, and I do not rely on the lifetime prior_no_show_flags, which is context only under POL-GEN-01; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; and the dwell finding is carried by EV-GPS-00203 at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor by POL-GEN-02. A clean record deserves a ruling.

ledger.claim: I concede the arithmetic, and I do not ask the judge to call 195 seconds 300. The driver's in-geofence hold runs from his first qualifying fix at 19:41:20 to his last at 19:44:35 - 195 seconds on a single continuous run of 21 fixes - against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 105 seconds; he cancelled at 19:44:40, roughly 200 seconds after that first fix. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore not met, and limb (d)'s requirement that termination come at or after the required dwell fails with it, so the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06 obliges a refund. I do not attempt limb (i) accumulation on top of that: the trace shows only one in-geofence run, so there is no second interval to sum, and EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - disclosed) - I assert nothing against that absent artifact. What the driver asks in return is narrow: that the ruling record a genuine arrival at the pin and a genuine 195-second hold, and impose nothing beyond the return of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee - no POL-NS-05 false-arrival referral against a driver who was stationary 18.7 m from the pin, and no POL-NS-09 escalation.
